usage: valvur update [-h] [--if-stale] [--prune] [--clear] [--build-index] [path]

positional arguments:
  path           Also fetch OSV's databases for the lockfiles in this project, when absent or
                 stale, so a scan with no network has them (a pipeline step's first half).

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --if-stale     Refresh only what a scan would refresh now: the database, the index, the
                 malicious list, KEV or EPSS, each when absent or past its age. Cheap enough to
                 put in a pre-commit hook, a cron entry or CI — the freshness check needs no
                 network at all.
  --prune        Fetch nothing; remove the published image's local tags that are not this shim's
                 version, and index files the metadata no longer names, each listed first. Never
                 the database, never this shim's image. `valvur doctor` shows what is cached.
  --clear        Fetch nothing; remove the vulnerability database, the package-name index and the
                 KEV copy. Waits for a running scan. The next scan fetches them again.
  --build-index  Build the package-name index from the registries themselves instead of pulling
                 the published one. Minutes rather than seconds; what the daily workflow that
                 publishes the index runs, and the fallback when it is unreachable.
